verdict.rationale: Channel3's Mintlify-hosted API reference provides a per-endpoint "Try it" playground that runs requests against the production API. It is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec and .md/llms.txt mirrors of every page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, and a sandbox or test-mode option (examples run only against production with a real key).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the "Try it" playground per endpoint, with llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and .md mirrors of every page.
The runner mounts client-side and executes against the production API with a real key.
Channel3 publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document
